captions.instagram:
Which trade has the slowest website?

We tested 12,621 Australian small-business websites with Google Lighthouse on a simulated mid-range phone. Pool builders came last: the median site took 8.1 seconds to show its main content. Solar installers took 7.8 and plumbers 6.5. Electricians and builders were quickest, at 5.6.

Google calls 2.5 seconds good. Even the fastest trade took more than twice that in Google’s lab test.
